title: Observer position is not body position
observed: At t0, the reported position is (10, 10).
At t1, the reported position is (400, 900).
The human changed only remote-view/camera state between observations.
concluded: The player physically moved roughly a thousand tiles.
floorboard: A field named position was treated as though its referent were permanently bound to the physical character body.
missing_evidence: Which entity or observer the position field actually describes in each controller state.
Whether physical character coordinates changed at all.

ferret.intervention: Hold the character body fixed, move only the camera/view, and observe every exposed position-like field.
ferret.if_claim: The body-corresponding position changes with the camera despite the controlled stationary character.
ferret.if_floorboard: A view/observer field changes while a separately observed body position remains fixed.
